usedFor: SimpleCert holds certificates, recipients and projects, and Microsoft Excel logs them as rows through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Recipient Added” in SimpleCert, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every recipient lands as a new row, so the sheet becomes a running list of who was added.

watchOut: SimpleCert triggers such as “New Recipient Added” are polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check.
